notes.title: Coming Soon: New DLC & Free Features Introducing the ECO Trait
notes.content:
Hello there, Delivery Managers,

we are enthusiastic to announce a brand-new DLC for Delivery Inc packed with fresh gameplay twists!

In this upcoming DLC, you will gain access to the automatic features of the new autonomous vehicles. Customize and experiment with your fleet, or even go fully autonomous to build your passive income empire. The possibilities are plentiful. With the introduction of self-driving services, expect new challenges as customers arrive with unique and demanding requirements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/9b09e82fe680e52b750907cf9fb878050278715f.gif

Embark on a new campaign featuring none other than Mr. Husk and Mr. Li. Meet those two entrepreneurs on their journey to dominate Sydney with evolving automation, and learn along the campaign how the autonomous logistics work!

More details are available on the DLC's Steam page. Don’t forget to wishlist (Smart Fleet) today!


Alongside the DLC, a free update is also rolling out!

 ECO Trait: This update brings a new ECO trait for vehicles, challenging you with deals and customers requiring ECO standards. It’s time to go green, or go home.
 Fuel Costs: Fuel isn’t free anymore! You’ll now need to factor in fuel expenses, adding a new layer of strategy to every delivery decision.

Step up your game and prove you're the ultimate Delivery Manager! Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3577100/Delivery_INC__Smart_Fleet/

notes.title: Major Update & Large Cargo DLC Release!
notes.content:
The “Large Cargo” DLC is available for purchase today and we’ve packed in a major update to go along with it. There is a lot of fresh content to explore for new and old players.

LARGE CARGO DLC

Specialty vehicles, a new delivery type, and brand new campaign awaits you. The Large Cargo DLC gives players a fun and challenging new way to experience delivery management, including 8 new achievements to master. 

Furniture, appliances, and other oddly shaped things need to be delivered. Send vehicles that can accommodate the awkward shapes and make sure your driver is strong enough to handle the heavy cargo. Strategize to speed up cargo deliveries by assigning an assistant driver to help or equipping the appropriate upgrade. Purchase the Large Cargo DLC today:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666560/Delivery_INC__Large_Cargo/

FREE CONTENT UPDATE - Version 1.5.0

We’ve been testing new features in the Open Beta for a while now and are happy to announce that they are ready for full release! Thank you to everyone that played the beta versions and provided feedback. The new features are listed below:


 New upgrade “Refrigerated Trunk” will give extra time to deliver cold food deals and less time to deliver hot food deals

 Employees can now be leveled up to level 25. Each level will give the option for a new reward for that employee. Experience points are earned by completing deliveries. If an assistant is assigned to a vehicle, they will receive some of the experience points for deliveries they help with

 Every Free Play city has a trophy that can be earned for completing all 20 free play challenges

 The unlock case has been updated adding more items that can be unlocked. Check the unlocks case in the main menu to see all unlocks.

 An “idle vehicle” button has been added to quickly select a vehicle in need of instructions.

 Deliveries that have only been partially picked up are now more clearly marked on the map

 Upon completing a city campaign, you will now have the option to continue playing in free play mode keeping all company progress made

Co-op Entering Open Beta Soon

Want to try to play Delivery INC with a friend? A new update to the Open Beta branch is on the way that will let you do just that! If you are interested in more information, join our Discord for updates on when it will be available.

For those that are interested, a full list of patch notes can be found below. Thanks for all of your support! More DLC and free updates are in progress.
- DigiFox Team

FULL PATCH NOTES FOR VERSION 1.5.0

 Large Cargo DLC released
 Added “refrigerated trunk” upgrade
 Added “leveling up drivers” feature
 Added “Free Play Trophies”
 Added new unlockable items
 “Idle Vehicle” button added
 Partially picked up deals are now more clearly marked on the map
 Completing a city campaign will now provide the option to continue playing in free play mode
 Fixed missing or broken translations for some UI elements
 Fixed minor graphical issues with icons and other UI elements
 Fixed audio issues where music would sometimes overlap and some sound effects would play at the incorrect volume
 Vehicles no longer “teleport” when using the TAB key to stop them
 Improved the maintenance tab functionality
 Players can not toggle on/off the idle vehicle status icon in settings
 When alt-tabbing to another screen, the game camera no longer shakes
 Fixed a rounding error with company average rating
 Fixed an issue where vehicles would not follow directions properly when dropping off two deliveries at the same location
 Adjusted icons in reviews so they better match what type of delivery it was
 Fixed an error that could occur when trying to recolor vehicles
 Job advertisements no longer require ALL options to be selected
 The keyboard arrow keys can now be used to switch vehicle in the upgrade menu
 When a vehicle returns from repairs, the repair icon is no longer shown on the vehicle
 Pop-ups no longer show incorrect stats for drivers
 The Franken Driver event will no longer crash the game for some players
 Placing a reckless driver into a vehicle will no longer play the speed up sound for the vehicle
 The animations for the goals menu in Free Play now play as they should
 The bicycle top down view is now correctly displayed when the tandem upgrade is applied
 When the player tries to start a day with unused vehicles still in their garage, they are warned and given the chance to add those vehicles to their fleet
 Players can now rename units to custom names
 The Tokyo Campaign completed animation now plays correctly
 Fixed an issue where equipping the Canopy Cover onto the Moped would sometimes crash the game
 Vehicles that are being repaired can no longer be upgraded until they are back from repairs
 If a player’s save data is somehow corrupted, the game will handle the issue automatically to make sure the player is able to continue playing the game
 Rebalanced drivers that appear for hire
 Rebalanced advertisements
 Adjusted minimum time between deal spawns
 Unlockables menu updated to show all ways to unlock rewards

This update focuses on adding more settings to free play based on player feedback. We've also made improvements to animations and overall polish. We hope you enjoy the update. If you feel free play is still missing something, please let us know.

DELIVERY INC - Patch Notes 1.1.1

 Players can now choose their starting location and map size in free play
 Added more settings to free play mode for a more customizable experience
 Improved balancing of free play challenges
 Fixed a major issue where maps would not load
 Fixed an issue where the Moscow campaign could not be completed
 Fixed a rare major issue where deals would not spawn and zooming would not work in free play mode

notes.title: Campaign Reveal - Developer Update
notes.content:
Campaign Reveal - Developer Update
The Delivery INC campaign has been in development for the last few months. We are excited to show you a peek into the campaign mode for Delivery INC, a journey through different cities with unlockables, challenges, and exciting stories.

Campaign Overview
Each campaign city has a reason for your arrival. New York is struggling with an influx of visitors because of the Times Square New Year’s Eve event and the mayor needs your help. Mr. Ramsay is starting a ghost kitchen in London to get into the lucrative food delivery business. He needs a talented delivery manager on his team and he’s chosen you for the job. Each city has unique characters that are requesting your delivery management skills. Some cities are available from the start and more can be unlocked by earning stars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/72235c14122fa4c0acc9881b116c7be02cd28b73.png

Earning these stars is no easy task. Each campaign has challenges that you must complete to earn stars. Earn enough stars and you will unlock new rewards. It’s not just about unlocking the next city. You’ll also earn other rewards like new vehicles, upgrades, restrictions and more along the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/f5c1a222d76032b61dba1662cd0996605bd32a83.gif

Restrictions are special rewards for the most hardcore players. Restrictions are optional game settings in Free Play mode that increase the difficulty level. For example, the “Extra Police” restriction adds more cops on the map. The “Faulty Vehicles” restriction, makes vehicles gain faults far more frequently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/8cb53a2c2c2ee802a593f5839a6fd3b559c58858.png

Each campaign city has one of these restrictions enabled. If you can complete every challenge for a city in a single playthrough, you will unlock that cities’ restriction in Free Play mode. You can also try to get 5 platinum stars if you’re a REALLY hardcore player, but we will let you figure out how to achieve that.

Watch the Campaign on YouTube
We are currently collaborating with YouTubers to give you an early look at Delivery INC. Orbital Potato and Dad's Gaming Addiction have videos uploaded sharing a sneak peek into the game’s campaign mode. Click the links below to watch their videos.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MiTxyDEWNm0 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=plF9RPQt5OM 
If you are a content creator interested in trying an early build of Delivery INC, feel free to reach out to us.

Get Involved!
Don’t miss your chance to chat directly with the developers and give us your feedback. Let us know what you think about the campaign! Your input will help us improve the game and give the best delivery management experience to our players.

Join our Discord now and start sharing your thoughts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/24040c0fa9debeb575b6206f8cdd8b49ecd927f9.png


If you haven’t wishlisted Delivery INC yet, click the wishlist button now and click follow so you don’t miss more updates like this one.

notes.title: Post Demo Update
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest: Delivery Complete!
It has been almost a month now since the Steam Next Fest. As many of you know, we had a demo available during the festival. We were thrilled to see so many of you downloading and trying the demo! Since then, we’ve been hard at work reviewing the feedback, survey responses, and bug reports.

Survey Results
The Delivery INC Demo was rated 8.2 out of 10! Thanks to the helpful feedback provided from the community, we are confident that we will raise that rating even higher.

92% of players reported that the game difficulty was just right. We designed Delivery INC with the goal of creating a challenging yet enjoyable experience, and these findings suggest that we have succeeded in achieving that balance.

83% would recommend the game to their friends.  This is great to hear because we are working on adding a co-op option to Delivery INC. Soon you will be able to play with the friends you recommend the game to.

Feedback & Features

Improvements to Vehicle Damage
In the demo, vehicles could have “permanent damage” where some of the faults were unrepairable. After hearing your feedback, we are changing this feature to “severe damage” instead. These damages will be repairable now, but you will have to send the vehicle off for repairs making it unavailable for a day or two.

When is the game launching on Steam?
The project has officially been greenlit to be published as soon as possible! Over the next few months, our main focus will be working on the game’s single player campaign as well as the additional features mentioned above. We will share progress with you as we go and announce a release date as soon as we can.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/f8f2e0fa4a859080afb5235a072565956fabe77e.png

Thanks again to everyone that played the demo and provided feedback. As promised, we will be selecting a few of those people randomly and rewarding them with a free copy of the game as soon as it becomes available. If you missed the demo during the Steam Next Fest, please consider joining our Discord! Our members may have more opportunities to play the game early.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/24040c0fa9debeb575b6206f8cdd8b49ecd927f9.png

Cheers! 
- DigiFox Team

notes.title: Delivery INC - Situations Showcase
notes.content:
Help! We’ve got a situation here…

Over the last few months, we’ve been fully focused on adding a feature we like to call “Situations”. Your delivery drivers will occasionally find themselves facing a difficult challenge and they will reach out to you for helpful advice. What kind of challenges will they encounter? Let’s take a look at an example:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/50d1f54a65c1e853529830bc94f915e1b7cb342f.png

Oops, this is what you get when you ignore people’s special requests for there to be no food in the vehicle. Now you’ve got a nasty situation on your hands. What advice would you give your employee Lewis in this case? 

Your choices matter

Hope you choose wisely, because in Delivery INC your decisions have a chance to affect gameplay. Your vehicle could get damaged, a bad review could be left, your income could be reduced, and much more. The consequences aren’t always bad though. You could also earn extra money, guarantee a 5 star review, have a driver gain a positive trait, and many other things.

Randomness and risks keeps things fresh

We have been working to create lots of interesting and unique situations that can occur with your drivers. The little bits of randomness we’ve sprinkled in help keep things feeling fresh each time you encounter them. You will not always be able to remember the correct choices to get the best outcome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/b13ced46ff1682b4fc122f0e615b9d4bb38bf516.png

My personal favorite example of this is our “accident” situation. Someone has crashed into your driver’s vehicle and you must take steps to help handle the situation. The first time you encounter it, it might be a young man behind the wheel. The second time, an elderly lady. The third, a businessman. They will each react differently to the choices you are given. 
You can even take a chance on bribing the businessman to pay you enough money for a replacement vehicle. If it works you’ll have enough cash to buy the delivery vehicle of your dreams, but what if it fails? How will he react to you trying to bribe him? Is the risk worth it?

Many paths to explore

We’re crafting each situation with exploration in mind. We want to deliver plenty of choices for you to traverse and enjoy. Our goal is to make these situations an exciting adventure. Even if you’ve already encountered the situation before, you might find a path that ends in a better result.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/38aee504fe29c8d18c2661146a213e1ccc6f5975.gif

More Coming Soon!
Our new year’s resolution is to get a demo of Delivery INC into your hands as soon as possible. Keep an eye out for a demo during the Steam Next Fest! From all of us at Digifox, we wish you all a happy holiday and a wonderful new year.

Stay safe!
- Digifox Team

notes.title: Delivery INC - Developer Update
notes.content:
Your Delivery Has Arrived!

Digifox here! We launched Transport INC in 2020. Transport INC is about the transportation business on a large scale where you’re responsible for transporting people and cargo from city to city and even country to country. We’ve teamed up with Games Operators again to bring a new transportation idea to life. In Delivery INC, we’re zooming way in to explore the delivery business on a much smaller scale. This means you’ll be getting a much more personal experience with your customers and staff. Delivery INC has been in development for a while now and we are excited to finally share our progress with you.

Progress Update

Right now, we are just finishing up the Alpha phase of development. Almost all of the core mechanics are in place. We’ve also been busy doing a graphics overhaul to make the game look as good as it can. Check how the visuals of the game have changed in the last few months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/d07872f086dd27500633bcae78a2a6c6352fafce.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/b2a5c60b09beed3a622fc76f63a97eb648a94984.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/4b4835946b265f8d7f0f8af66ad984fcfbaa3101.png
Gameplay Overview Trailer

We’ve prepared a video diving deeper into some of the game mechanics of Delivery INC. All footage is 100% gameplay. You’re seeing the game as it looks and plays today, but keep in mind that it’s still a work in progress. We are always making improvements and there are even more features being added.

[previewyoutube=p3XEtlt9Fcw;full][/previewyoutube]

Get Involved!


The Digifox Discord now has a section dedicated to Delivery INC. You can join today to ask any question you might have and even participate in contests to get your ideas into the game!  In Delivery INC, customers leave short reviews based on their experience. Some reviews are serious while others are funny. If you were the customer, what review would you leave? Once per week, we will give a delivery scenario in our Discord giving you a chance to write a short customer review. We will read all submitted reviews and pick some of our favorites. If your customer review is chosen, it will be added to the game. Not only that, but we will also include your name in the game's credits! We can't wait to read the amazing customer reviews our community writes. Thanks for getting involved and supporting Delivery INC. Good luck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522566/24040c0fa9debeb575b6206f8cdd8b49ecd927f9.png

Play The Demo

Our next goal is to release a public demo so you can get a hands-on experience of Delivery INC. If you are interested in playing the demo, be sure to click the follow button in the Delivery INC Steam News Hub. You’ll be notified by email as soon as the Demo is available.

That’s all for now! Please leave your feedback and suggestions in the comments. We can’t wait to hear what you think about Delivery INC.
